name: MMBench-EN
intro: MMBench-EN 是 MMBench 的英文子集/分项，报告中用于观察多模态模型英文视觉问答表现。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanyang Technological University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 三级能力体系, 志愿者多源收集, 文本可答与错题双路质量过滤
eval_feature: 英文视觉问答, CircularEval, 选项抽取
scale: 3,217道题, 20个细粒度能力, 开发/测试=4:6
build_method_en: Three-level ability taxonomy, volunteer multi-source collection, text-only and wrong-item quality filtering
eval_feature_en: English Visual QA, CircularEval, Choice extraction
intro_en: MMBench-EN is the English subset or breakdown of MMBench used in reports to inspect multimodal English visual-QA performance.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2307.06281 Sections 3-5. MMBench-EN is the original English version: a three-level perception/reasoning taxonomy with 20 leaf abilities, 10-20 seed MCQs per ability, and student-volunteer expansion from Internet and public-validation sources. Text-only majority success and all-VLM failure each trigger manual review. The final 3,217 image-grounded 2-4 choice questions are split dev/test 4:6. Evaluation first extracts choices heuristically, falls back to GPT-4-0125, and applies CircularEval, requiring every rotated-choice pass to be correct before reporting overall and ability-level accuracy.
